mechanism: Fenofibrate may increase perphenazine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and displacement from protein binding, while perphenazine may potentiate fenofibrate's lipid-lowering effects and increase myopathy risk.
action: Monitor for perphenazine toxicity signs (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation) and myopathy symptoms; consider dose adjustment of perphenazine if needed and maintain regular lipid/CK monitoring.
